translations.web: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
translations.bsb: Do not speak to a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
translations.kjv: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
translations.asv: Speak not in the hearing of a fool; For he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
